policy: No code or shader instruction extraction from Xpsb.so or psb_dri.so. psb_dri.so is permitted for non-extractive reference only. No use of the original 440-byte Poulsbo shader image. All new shader instructions must be independently developed with evidence.
method: Provenance and dependency metadata only; no source body or payload inspection.

historical_fragment_dependency.replacement_needed: ONLY if specific dependency on excluded DDK references or another independently established permission defect is demonstrated; no blanket replacement because historical.
historical_fragment_dependency.function_symbols: individual emitter/array symbol names not recorded in audited build metadata; no body/binary inspection performed

current_decision: Historical fragment-construction dependency is recorded as psb_dri.so-derived with Xpsb corroboration. It is not reused as a new shader template or encoder. This does not prohibit other already-cleared Poulsbo public material.
exact_440_byte_asset_path: UNKNOWN; do not equate 1245-byte header with 440-byte binary image.
new_host_candidate: No frozen/Poulsbo program image inputs in actual Mesa driver overlay; unknown hardware encoders remain ENOTSUP.
quarantine_scope: Logical exclusion from new shader implementation/admission of proprietary extracted instruction assets, including the forbidden 440-byte image. No old evidence files moved or rewritten.
